implemented_requirements.requirement: Display a 3x3 grid of clickable cells for moves
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py builds a 3x3 grid of tk.Button widgets inside a Frame (lines creating self.cell_buttons).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Two players alternate turns placing X or O
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py stores player_x and player_o (Player objects) and switches self.current_player after each valid move in _handle_cell_click.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Validate moves (inside board and on empty cells)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.is_valid_move checks bounds and emptiness; Board.make_move returns False for illegal moves.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect a win (row, column, diagonal) and identify the winner
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.check_winner iterates over all lines from _all_lines and returns 'X' or 'O' when a line matches; game.py calls this after each move.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect a draw when the board is full with no winner
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.is_full returns True when all cells are occupied; game.py calls it after checking for a winner.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Highlight the winning line in the UI
implemented_requirements.evidence: game._end_round obtains board.get_winning_line() and sets the background of those buttons to WIN_COLOR (gold).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Track each player's win count and display a scoreboard
implemented_requirements.evidence: Player.record_win increments wins; game._update_scoreboard formats a label showing both players' wins and draws.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide a 'New Round' button that resets the board but keeps scores
implemented_requirements.evidence: game._new_round resets the Board, clears button states, and keeps win counters unchanged.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide a 'Reset Scores' button that clears win counters and starts a fresh round
implemented_requirements.evidence: game._reset_scores calls Player.reset_score for both players, zeroes draws, updates scoreboard, then calls _new_round.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Allow players to input custom names (optional but user‑friendly)
implemented_requirements.evidence: game._ask_player_names uses tkinter.simpledialog.askstring to let users set names; defaults are used if cancelled.

judge.summary: The submitted files implement a complete, functional tic‑tac‑toe game meeting all core requirements: a 3x3 Tkinter UI, two alternating players, move validation, win/draw detection, winning‑line highlighting, score tracking, and controls for new rounds and score resets. The code appears syntactically correct and ready to run, so the solution passes.
